technology_name: A SYSTEM FOR EVALUATING HUMAN RELATION MANAGEMENT IN AN ORGANIZATION USING SCANNER AND SMART DEVICES AND WORKING METHOD THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Traditional organizational human resource frameworks rely on manual surveys and decentralized feedback loops that fail to track relational cross-team friction or workplace sentiment trends in real time.
description: An automated organizational evaluation framework equipped with digital scanning modules and mobile client interfaces linked to a master database aggregation engine running dynamic query reconciliation algorithms to map human relation metrics.
applications: Corporate enterprise resource planning (ERP) platforms, smart workplace management dashboards, remote team performance tracking tools, and institutional operations analytics.
